text: Visible distill regressions require `_read_repo_file_snapshot` to use `selection='diff_hunks'` and `partial=True` for a large changed Python file while still including the late changed token and keeping `truncated=False`; they also require moderate `SPEC-v2.md` and `uv.lock` snapshots to stay complete and `_build_distill_target_capsules` to retain unchanged scope via `supporting_file_snapshots`.
